Top candidates: **Anthracnose** (dark irregular pod lesions, acervuli), **Cercospora** (reddish-purple on pods), **Phomopsis/Diaporthe** (pod blight).

Let me view reference images for these candidates.
The Anthracnose bottom-right panel shows green pods with dark irregular blotchy lesions that closely match the test image. Cercospora primarily shows leaf symptoms. Let me check one more candidate.

Diaporthe shows stem blight with linear pycnidia rows — not matching. The test image clearly shows pods with large irregular dark purple-brown blotchy lesions on green pods, which matches the Anthracnose reference (bottom-right panel) and description: "dark irregularly shaped spots on pods."
